pages.quiz:
GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which German word or phrase means "sky"? (1 mark)
   A. der Regenbogen
   B. der Regen
   C. der Himmel
   D. der Nebel

2. Which German word is the number 15? (1 mark)
   A. fünfzehn
   B. neunzehn
   C. null
   D. eins

3. Which German word or phrase means "knee"? (1 mark)
   A. das Ohr
   B. das Knie
   C. der Bauch
   D. der Zahn

4. Which word is a temperature word? (1 mark)
   A. Regen
   B. kalt
   C. Wind
   D. Wolke

5. Which food group does "die Karotte" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. die Getränke
   B. das Obst
   C. das Gemüse
   D. das Fleisch

6. What does "lecker" mean? (1 mark)
   A. big
   B. tasty
   C. cold
   D. healthy

7. Which little word goes with the noun "Hand"? (1 mark)
   A. den
   B. der
   C. die
   D. das

8. Which German word or phrase means "milk"? (1 mark)
   A. der Saft
   B. die Kartoffel
   C. der Apfel
   D. die Milch

9. Which food group does "die Mango" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. das Gemüse
   B. die Getränke
   C. das Fleisch
   D. das Obst

10. Which mark shows that a sentence is a question? (1 mark)
   A. das Fragezeichen (?)
   B. der Punkt (.)
   C. das Ausrufezeichen (!)
   D. das Komma (,)

11. What does "Es geht" mean as an answer to "Wie geht's?" (1 mark)
   A. It is so-so
   B. It is goodbye
   C. It is very bad
   D. It is very good

12. What is the plural of "die Kerze"? (1 mark)
   A. die Kerzer
   B. die Kerzen
   C. die Kerzes
   D. die Kerze

13. What does "das Knie" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. ear
   B. knee
   C. finger
   D. neck

14. What does "Wir wohnen in einem Haus" mean? (1 mark)
   A. We play in a garden
   B. We cook in a house
   C. We sell a house
   D. We live in a house

15. Which adjective is made from "Wolke"? (1 mark)
   A. wolkin
   B. wolke
   C. wolken
   D. wolkig

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Explain how to say the letters z, w and v in German words. Give one example each. (3 marks)

17. Write the German words with der, die or das for: supper, shower, bean, fork. (4 marks)

18. Write the German words with der, die or das for: knee, garden. (2 marks)

19. Write the German words with der, die or das for: song, juice, egg. (3 marks)

20. Write three sentences about what you do on three different days. Start each with "Am". (3 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — der Himmel
   sky in German is der Himmel.

2. A — fünfzehn
   15 in German is fünfzehn.

3. B — das Knie
   knee in German is das Knie.

4. B — kalt
   kalt means cold.

5. C — das Gemüse
   die Karotte belongs to das Gemüse.

6. B — tasty
   lecker means tasty.

7. C — die
   It is die Hand, so the little word is die.

8. D — die Milch
   milk in German is die Milch.

9. D — das Obst
   die Mango belongs to das Obst.

10. A — das Fragezeichen (?)
   The question mark is das Fragezeichen.

11. A — It is so-so
   Es geht means it is okay, so-so.

12. B — die Kerzen
   The plural of die Kerze is die Kerzen.

13. B — knee
   das Knie means knee.

14. D — We live in a house
   wohnen means to live and wir means we.

15. D — wolkig
   Wolke + -ig gives wolkig, cloudy.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: z is ts (Zahl), w is v (Wasser), v is f in most words (Vater).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sound and example.

17. (4 marks)
   Answer: das Abendessen, die Dusche, die Bohne, die Gabel.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: das Knie, der Garten.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: das Lied, der Saft, das Ei.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Am Montag gehe ich zur Schule. Am Samstag spiele ich Fußball. Am Sonntag gehe ich in die Kirche.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence with a capital letter, verb in second place and a full stop.
